issuer: the driving licence authority (Führerscheinbehörde): the district authority (Bezirkshauptmannschaft) or, in a city with one, the regional police directorate (Landespolizeidirektion)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on oesterreich.gv.at, the federal government's citizens' portal. Its page on the minimum ages gives class B from 18 (B at 17, the L17 accompanied scheme, isn't held); its page on getting a licence gives the issuing fee (Erteilungsgebühr) as €90, without the medical examination and the test fees, which aren't held; its photocard page says cards issued from 19 January 2013 are limited to 15 years, an administrative term for renewing the document. The national identity card (Personalausweis) is the ids engine's, not held here. No exchange list was read.
